title: Critical Acclaim Volatility
scenario: For each genre, calculate the difference between the maximum and minimum critic_score for games released in the same year.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR, release_year INT), ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC)
hint: Use MAX() OVER(PARTITION BY genre, release_year).
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT genre, release_year, MAX(critic_score) OVER(PARTITION BY genre, release_year) - MIN(critic_score) OVER(PARTITION BY genre, release_year) as volatility FROM games g JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR, release_year INT); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, critic_score NUMERIC);
